What we do

Air conditioning and electrical, residential and commercial.

From a breaker that will not stay in to a full system replacement, and everything in between.

AC Repair

Not cooling, tripping the breaker, freezing up, or making a sound it never made before. We find it, explain it, and give you the number before we start.

New Systems & Replacements

Sized for the house rather than swapped for whatever was there before, and priced so you can compare properly.

Electrical Service & Repair

Outlets, switches, lighting, dead circuits and the mystery breaker nobody has been able to sort out.

Panels & Rewiring

Panel upgrades, service changes and rewires for older Clewiston houses that were never built for what we plug into them now.

New Construction & Remodels

Rough in through final, electrical and mechanical together, on a schedule that does not hold up the rest of the trades.

Commercial

Shops, offices and agricultural buildings across the Glades. Work scheduled around your hours, not ours.

Why it matters

Two licenses, one company, no finger pointing.

Most contractors hold one. Taylor Electric holds both: a certified electrical contractor license and a certified air conditioning contractor license, in the same company, since 2015.

  • One number to call. A new system that needs a dedicated circuit is one job here, not two companies and two schedules.
  • Nobody blames the other trade. When one crew owns the wire and the equipment, the fault is ours to find and ours to fix.
  • Permits pulled properly. Both licenses are certified statewide, so the paperwork is done right and the inspection passes.
  • Family run. James and Candace have owned it since day one, and it is still the two of them answering for the work.
